The '''LCS 2021 Summer''' was the second split of the 2021 season of the [[League of Legends Championship Series]] (LCS), organized by Riot Games. It took place from June 4 to August 29, 2021, with all matches played online and broadcast from Los Angeles, United States. Ten franchised teams competed in a Triple Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo1}} Group Stage, followed by a Double Elimination {{Abbr/Bo5}} Playoff bracket known as the LCS Championship. Unlike previous years, the split continued the 2021 format introduced in Spring, with regular season records carrying over from the previous split. The total prize pool was $200,000 USD, and the top three teams qualified for the [[World Championship/2021|2021 World Championship]].

The summer season revealed just a few roster changes, with [[Evil Geniuses]] benching {{player|Deftly|flag=us}} to promote {{player|Danny|flag=us}}, the Spring [[Evil Geniuses Prodigies]] midlaner <ref name="Danny promoted">{{cite web |url=https://twitter.com/EvilGeniuses/status/1393281207140454401 |title=@EG_Danny will be our first player promoted from Prodigies to the #LCS as our starting ADC. |date=2021-05-14 |author=[[Evil Geniuses]] |publisher=Twitter |language={{Flag|usuk}} English}}</ref>, while [[Cloud9]] decided to move {{player|Zven|flag=dk}} to their academy team, promoting {{player|K1ng|flag=au}} <ref name="-zven +k1ng"> {{cite web |url=https://twitter.com/Cloud9/status/1398715767844065280 |title=#C9LoL 2021 #LCS Summer Split Roster Update |date=2021-05-29 |author=[[Cloud9]] |publisher=Twitter |language={{Flag|usuk}} English}}</ref>. In an attempt to improve their 10th place spring split, [[Golden Guardians]] signed {{player|Solo|flag=us}}, while promoting {{player|Chime|flag=ca}} to the main roster <ref name="Summer 2021">{{cite web |url=https://twitter.com/GoldenGuardians/status/1394004900443426816 |title=Your Summer 2021 GG Starting LCS Roster. |date=2021-05-16 |author=[[Golden Guardians]] |publisher=Twitter |language={{Flag|usuk}} English}}</ref>.

===LCS Championship 2021===
{{#lst:LCS/2021/Summer/Playoffs|Playoffs}}


==Format==
* '''Group Stage''' - ''June 4th - August 1st, 2021''
** Triple Round Robin
** Each team plays 27 matches.
** All matches are played in a {{Abbr/Bo1}}
** Unlike previous editions, records are carried over from [[LCS/2021/Spring/Group Stage|LCS Spring Group Stage]].

* '''Playoffs''' - now known as ''LCS Championship''
** Top 8 qualify for the LCS Championship
** 1st and 2nd starts in the Upper Bracket Round 2,
** 3rd, 4th, 5th and 6th starts in the Upper Bracket Round 1,
** 7th and 8th start in the Lower Bracket.
** Double Elimination
** All matches are played in a {{Abbr/Bo5}} 
** Top 3 teams will be qualified for [[World_Championship/2021|Worlds 2021]]
